...and by carrying
...and imparts impurity in a tent
...and it counts toward the number of one hundred and twenty-five
R' Yochanan: and [the baraita speaks] of one counted along the back of the hand
Rav: an extra digit that has a bone and no nail imparts impurity by contact
Rav: ...and by carrying

R' Yochanan: and [Rav speaks] of one NOT counted along the back of the hand

Rav Huna bar Manoach in the name of Rav Acha breih deRav Ika: they dealt with it as a bone the size of a barley grain
Rav Pappa: a decree -- the uncounted digit on account of the counted one
the Rabbis made a distinguishing mark, so that teruma and consecrated food not be burned on their account
the mishna (Oholot 2:1): most of the frame or most of the number [of bones] of a corpse, though there is not a quarter-kav in it, are impure
what is most of its frame? two shins and one thigh
since [these are] most of the height of a tall man
what is most of its number? one hundred and twenty-five
the baraita: one lacking, who has only two hundred, and one with extra, who has two hundred and eighty-one -- all count toward the number of one hundred and twenty-five
go by the majority of people

perhaps you examined a woman, to whom Scripture added two hinges and two doors
R' Elazar: as a house has hinges, so a woman has hinges

R' Yehoshua: as a house has doors, so a woman has doors

R' Akiva: as a house has a key, so a woman has a key

Rav: and all of them [the woman's additional limbs] do not impart impurity in a tent
Rav's verse: 'this is the law: a person [adam] who dies in a tent' (Num 19:14)
Rav: [tent-impurity requires] a thing alike in every person
